video_description: A person carries a long cardboard box of flowers from the hallway into the room.
Several people are gathered around a dining table covered with a pink-and-white checkered tablecloth.
<voice_430> discusses the idea of buying flowers rather than trying to grow plants during a short shooting period.
The person carrying the box places it on the center of the table in front of the group.
<voice_595> explains that the flowers were shipped from Yunnan and mentions having ordered peonies.
A woman with light reddish-blonde hair helps open the cardboard box on the table.
The woman unpacks the protective paper wrap to check the flowers inside.
A woman wearing a white shirt stands up from the table and walks toward the back of the room.
high_level_conclusions: The package contains fresh cut flowers (peonies) ordered as props or materials for an ongoing video shoot.
<voice_595> is the person who purchased the fresh flowers shipped by express delivery from Yunnan.
